notes: Partition verified: all 24 source and 33 target ids used exactly once.

The of of 'any of the things' is correctly on miṣwōṯ: kōl is a construct noun and miṣwōṯ is its nomen rectum, so rule 19 puts the relational of there and leaves the min free to take the written in. This is why the placement differs from LEV.4.13, 4.22 and 4.27, where the ASV writes a different count of function words.

The two partitive min morphemes of mēʾaḥaṯ mēhēnnâ are counted against the ASV's any and of, as rule 42 counts waws against ands; the unit note records the competing reading that gives any to ʾaḥaṯ under rule 15.
